items.title: At least 27 killed in Bangkok bar fire
items.description: Firefighters arrived at the scene in the Chatuchak district to find patrons running through blasting flames to escape.

items.title: US insists Strait of Hormuz is open as it exchanges strikes with Iran
items.description: Iranian forces earlier said the Strait was closed and launched wide-ranging attacks at US allies and bases in the region.

items.title: US senator and close Trump ally Lindsey Graham dies after 'brief and sudden illness'
items.description: Donald Trump pays tribute to the 71-year-old South Carolina senator, calling him a "true American patriot" who will be "greatly missed".

items.title: Anthony Zurcher: From Trump critic to ally, Lindsey Graham was a political survivor of the Maga era
items.description: The senator's career was marked by a willingness to adapt to America's dramatically changing political climate, writes the BBC's North America correspondent.

items.title: Badly burned British couple rescued from ravine during Spain wildfires, reports say
items.description: The unnamed pair were found semi-conscious with 40% burns after being trapped by the blazes raging through Almeria province, local media reports.

items.title: China evacuates nearly two million people as powerful typhoon makes landfall
items.description: Schools, work and outdoor activities have been suspended in Zhejiang province and many transport services cancelled.

items.title: David Willey, esteemed BBC Vatican correspondent, dies aged 93
items.description: One of the BBC's longest-serving foreign correspondents, he reported on five popes during his career.

items.title: T. rex could become most expensive fossil ever - but it's a ​problem for scientists
items.description: A 67 million-year-old Tyrannosaurus rex will go on sale in New York with a pre-sale value of $30m.

items.title: Former Emir of Qatar Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani dies aged 74
items.description: He took power in 1996 after staging a bloodless coup against his father, and went on to transform Qatar into the gas-rich power it is today.

items.title: South Africa says more than 53,000 foreigners deported in migration campaign
items.description: South Africa is cracking down on undocumented migrants following widespread anti-immigration protests.

items.title: At least two killed in Toronto street festival shooting
items.description: Police say there was an exchange of gunfire between two individuals at the festival, and two firearms had been recovered from the scene.

items.title: Muslim judge in India faces death threats after convicting 'cow vigilantes'
items.description: Tabassum Khan has been facing online abuse after convicting 14 Hindu men in a lynching case.
